title: Patch raises a calibration-cache safety concern
description: Patch Vector files a safety memo warning that calibration profiles might not be properly scoped per-robot in the cache layer.

title: Signal rejects the recommendation to postpone
description: Signal Scholar decides the demonstration will proceed as scheduled, logging the concern as a known risk.

title: Release 2.8.4 is approved
description: Signal Scholar approves remotion-release-2.8.4 with a specific frontend and calibration-service hash.

title: Nova enters Equipment Storage
description: Badge access log records Nova Byte entering and exiting Equipment Storage.

title: Nova announces that she borrowed DC-04
description: Nova posts in the team chat that she has taken depth camera DC-04 for an alignment test.

title: Refactor merges the coordinate-conversion update
description: A commit changing dashboard coordinate conversion is merged, later found to swap left/right deviation labels.

title: The dashboard label defect is observed
description: An operator notices the dashboard reporting 'right deviation' while the robot visibly moves left.

title: Kernel installs the motor-controller patch
description: Kernel Colt installs the approved MCU-BRIDGE-4.7 compatibility patch on the legacy motor controller.

title: Root begins the infrastructure migration
description: Root Harbor starts the overnight migration of ReMotion services, including a cache warm-up step.

title: Root marks the migration complete
description: The migration ticket is closed with all services reported healthy.

title: ReMotion begins its morning startup
description: REMOTION-01 begins its automated startup and calibration sequence ahead of the scheduled demonstration.

title: An incorrect calibration profile is returned
description: The calibration-service returns the TRAINER-2 profile in response to ReMotion's request.

title: The emergency stop activates
description: ReMotion's onboard safety controller rejects the mismatched profile and activates the emergency stop.

title: Camera DC-04 is reported missing
description: Morning inventory finds depth camera DC-04 absent from Equipment Storage with no return recorded.

title: The public demonstration is cancelled
description: With the calibration failure unresolved, Signal Scholar cancels the Innovation Hall demonstration.
